row.title: GitHub-only tenants serve their front end on their Worker from birth
row.body: Surfaces tested for switching GitHub Pages on: repo token (403), lane admin App (403, no Pages grant), gh-pages push by the repo token (branch pushed, Pages API 403). The tenant's Cloudflare Worker serves the site at its ultrastable.org address from the first deploy, and loop.yml keeps gh-pages current so Pages serves it the day a grant exists.
